basis: Sciatic nerve compression defines the syndrome; piriformis contraction does not establish intrinsic muscle damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: the muscle compresses the sciatic nerve, but intrinsic muscle damage is not established.

basis: Skeletal dysplasia and characteristic blepharophimosis define it; nail dysplasia and structural external-ear hypoplasia each occur in 30-79%.

decisions.ocular: primary: characteristic blepharophimosis is an eyelid malformation included in the disease definition.
decisions.otologic: involved: microtia is permanent external-ear hypoplasia, annotated in 30-79%; hearing loss is not required to recognize this structural defect.

basis: Chronic cutaneous hyperkeratosis defines EKV. Supplied 30-79% ocular/endocrine annotations conflict with its usual skin-limited course and do not establish common direct damage across the umbrella.

decisions.ocular: none: despite supplied 30-79% annotations, cataract/glaucoma are not established common direct manifestations across the EKV umbrella.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: the supplied diabetes frequency does not establish direct endocrine damage from EKV; diabetes is not a characteristic manifestation across this umbrella.

basis: Fatty-acid synthesis enzyme deficiency; global developmental delay occurs in 1/1 annotated patient. Myopathy has no frequency; hypotonia alone does not establish muscle disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: myopathy frequency is unspecified, and hypotonia in 1/1 patient does not independently establish intrinsic muscle damage.

basis: Larval tissue infection; CNS abnormalities occur in 80-99%, and intramuscular cystic lesions/abnormal muscle morphology in 30-79%. Muscle lesions may be asymptomatic; ocular disease is <30%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: larval cysts directly occupy muscle, with abnormal skeletal muscle morphology in 30-79%; absence of symptoms does not negate cystic tissue occupation.

basis: Very rare, variable chromosomal malformation syndrome with CNS/developmental and skeletal abnormalities. Individual supplied findings are only 5-29%; no additional involvement is established.

decisions.neurologic: primary: developmental impairment and congenital brain malformations are part of the syndrome's variable phenotype; their individual 5-29% frequencies make this assignment uncertain.

basis: Ovarian failure and skeletal abnormalities define it; hearing impairment and specific learning disability each occur in 30-79%. Hypertension, thyroiditis and steatosis are separate diseases.

decisions.neurologic: involved: specific learning disability is a neurodevelopmental manifestation annotated in 30-79%, distinct from the psychiatric and behavioral findings.

basis: Congenital muscular dystrophy with defining intellectual disability and brain malformations; defective dystroglycan glycosylation is an inherited metabolic disorder. Ocular findings 25%; cardiac <30%.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: POMT2-related dystroglycanopathy is an inherited O-glycosylation disorder, qualifying for the metabolic mechanism axis.

basis: Lysosomal lipid storage disorder; progressive neurologic damage in most and common hepatic disease, with hepatomegaly in 7/13. Splenic/marrow storage lacks established common functional impairment.

decisions.haematologic: none: splenomegaly in 4/13 and marrow histiocytosis demonstrate storage, but do not establish blood-organ dysfunction in at least 30%.

basis: Congenital tongue deficiency defines it; upper-airway obstruction and mandibular hypoplasia each occur in 30-79%. Limb findings may reflect broader OLHS; speech difficulty is mechanical.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: micrognathia represents mandibular hypoplasia and occurs in 30-79%; this supports the axis independently of limb findings from broader OLHS.
